source.text: וַתֵּצֵ֤א דִינָה֙ בַּת־לֵאָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָלְדָ֖ה לְיַעֲקֹ֑ב לִרְא֖וֹת בִּבְנ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: And went out Dinah, the daughter of Leah whom she had borne to Jacob, to see the daughters of the land.

en.L: And Dinah the daughter of Leah, whom she had borne to Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.
en.B: One day Dinah, Jacob's daughter by Leah, went out to get to know the young women of that country.
en.R: Dinah was the daughter of Jacob and Leah. One day she went out to meet some of the local young women.

es.L: Y salió Dina, la hija de Lea, a quien ella había dado a luz a Jacob, para ver a las hijas de la tierra.
es.B: Un día Dina, la hija que Jacob había tenido con Lea, salió a conocer a las jóvenes de aquella región.
es.R: Dina era hija de Jacob y de Lea. Un día salió a visitar a algunas muchachas del lugar.

fr.L: Et Dina, la fille de Léa, qu’elle avait enfantée à Jacob, sortit pour voir les filles du pays.
fr.B: Un jour, Dina, la fille que Léa avait donnée à Jacob, sortit pour faire connaissance avec les jeunes femmes de la région.
fr.R: Dina était la fille de Jacob et de Léa. Un jour, elle est sortie pour rencontrer des jeunes filles de l’endroit.

sw.L: Dina binti wa Lea, ambaye [Lea] alimzalia Yakobo, alitoka kwenda kuwaona binti za nchi.
sw.B: Siku moja Dina, binti ambaye Lea alimzalia Yakobo, alitoka kwenda kujuana na wasichana wa nchi ile.
sw.R: Dina alikuwa binti wa Yakobo na Lea. Siku moja alitoka kwenda kukutana na wasichana wa mahali pale.

decisions.choice: Dinah the daughter of Leah: Jacob's only daughter named
decisions.reason: Dinah's birth was told in 30:21. Naming her as Leah's daughter prepares for the part her full brothers, Leah's sons Simeon and Levi, will play (verse 25).

decisions.choice: to see the daughters of the land: to visit the local women
decisions.reason: The phrase means to spend time with the young women of the Canaanite town. The text does not blame Dinah; the blame in the chapter falls on Shechem (verses 2, 7, 13).

decisions.choice: passé simple (L, B); passé composé (R)
decisions.reason: The narrative tense follows the French style guide: the passé simple ("sortit"), the normal tense of written narrative, at Literal and Balanced; the passé composé ("est sortie"), as French is spoken and read in school today, at Readable. Speech keeps the tenses of speech at every level.

source.text: וַיַּ֨רְא אֹתָ֜הּ שְׁכֶ֧ם בֶּן־חֲמ֛וֹר הַֽחִוִּ֖י נְשִׂ֣יא הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיִּקַּ֥ח אֹתָ֛הּ וַיִּשְׁכַּ֥ב אֹתָ֖הּ וַיְעַנֶּֽהָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And saw her Shechem, son of Hamor the Hivite, the chief of the land, and he took her and lay [with] her and humbled her.

en.L: And Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the land, saw her, and he took her and lay with her and humbled her.
en.B: Shechem, the son of Hamor the Hivite who ruled that region, caught sight of her. He seized her and forced her to lie with him, and so he shamed her.
en.R: Shechem, the son of Hamor, saw Dinah. Hamor was a Hivite, the ruler of that area. Shechem grabbed Dinah and forced her to have sex with him. He brought shame on her.

es.L: Y la vio Siquem, hijo de Hamor el heveo, príncipe de la tierra, y la tomó, se acostó con ella y la humilló.
es.B: Siquem, hijo de Hamor el heveo, que gobernaba aquella región, la vio. La agarró y la obligó a acostarse con él; así la deshonró.
es.R: Siquem, el hijo de Hamor, vio a Dina. Hamor era heveo y gobernaba aquella zona. Siquem agarró a Dina y la obligó a tener relaciones sexuales con él. La deshonró.

fr.L: Et Sichem, fils de Hamor le Hévien, prince du pays, la vit ; il la prit, coucha avec elle et l’humilia.
fr.B: Sichem, fils de Hamor le Hévien, qui gouvernait la région, l’aperçut. Il s’empara d’elle et la força à coucher avec lui ; ainsi il la déshonora.
fr.R: Sichem, le fils de Hamor, a vu Dina. Hamor était un Hévien, le chef de cette région. Sichem a attrapé Dina et l’a forcée à avoir des relations sexuelles avec lui. Il l’a déshonorée.

sw.L: Naye Shekemu mwana wa Hamori Mhivi, mkuu wa nchi, akamwona, akamchukua, akalala naye, akamdhalilisha.
sw.B: Shekemu mwana wa Hamori Mhivi, aliyetawala eneo lile, akamwona. Akamkamata na kumlazimisha alale naye, akamtia aibu.
sw.R: Shekemu, mwana wa Hamori, alimwona Dina. Hamori alikuwa Mhivi, mtawala wa eneo lile. Shekemu akamkamata Dina na kumlazimisha kufanya naye ngono. Akamtia aibu.

decisions.choice: took her, lay with her and humbled her: he raped her
decisions.reason: The three verbs come one after another with no word of consent. The last, 'innah, means to humble or violate; it is used of the rape of Tamar (2 Samuel 13:12-14) and in the law on forcing a woman (Deuteronomy 22:29). Dinah's brothers call it defiling (verses 5, 13, 27).

decisions.choice: Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the land: the ruler of the city-state
decisions.reason: The Hivites were one of the peoples of Canaan (10:17). Hamor was the head of the town of Shechem, which bore his son's name. The word nasi' means a chief or leading man.

decisions.choice: forced her to lie with him (B); forced her to have sex with him (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make clear that this was done by force, as the verbs show (m1); Literal keeps the Hebrew wording.

source.text: וַתִּדְבַּ֣ק נַפְשׁ֔וֹ בְּדִינָ֖ה בַּֽת־יַעֲקֹ֑ב וַיֶּֽאֱהַב֙ אֶת־הַֽנַּעֲרָ֔ וַיְדַבֵּ֖ר עַל־לֵ֥ב הַֽנַּעֲרָֽ׃

records.literal_gloss: And clung his soul to Dinah, daughter of Jacob, and he loved the girl and spoke to [the] heart of the girl.

en.L: And his soul clung to Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the young woman and spoke to the heart of the young woman.
en.B: But then he became deeply attached to Dinah, Jacob's daughter. He fell in love with the girl and spoke to her gently to win her heart.
en.R: After that Shechem felt deeply attached to Dinah. He loved her and spoke gently to her, trying to win her over.

es.L: Y su alma se apegó a Dina, la hija de Jacob, y amó a la joven y habló al corazón de la joven.
es.B: Pero luego se encariñó profundamente con Dina, la hija de Jacob. Se enamoró de la muchacha y le habló con ternura para ganarse su corazón.
es.R: Después, Siquem sintió un gran apego por Dina. La amaba y le hablaba con cariño, tratando de conquistarla.

fr.L: Et son âme s’attacha à Dina, fille de Jacob ; il aima la jeune fille et parla au cœur de la jeune fille.
fr.B: Mais ensuite il s’attacha profondément à Dina, la fille de Jacob. Il tomba amoureux de la jeune fille et lui parla avec douceur pour gagner son cœur.
fr.R: Ensuite, Sichem s’est beaucoup attaché à Dina. Il l’aimait et lui parlait avec douceur pour la conquérir.

sw.L: Na nafsi yake ikaambatana na Dina binti Yakobo, akampenda msichana, akasema na moyo wa msichana.
sw.B: Lakini baadaye moyo wake ukashikamana sana na Dina, binti Yakobo. Akampenda msichana huyo, akazungumza naye kwa upole ili kuuvuta moyo wake.
sw.R: Baadaye Shekemu alivutiwa sana na Dina. Akampenda, akazungumza naye kwa upole, akijaribu kumvuta moyo.

decisions.choice: his soul clung to Dinah: he was strongly attached to her
decisions.reason: Clinging (davaq) is the word for a husband holding to his wife (2:24). The order is jarring: the violence comes first, the love afterward.

decisions.choice: spoke to the heart of the girl: tried to comfort and win her
decisions.reason: To speak to someone's heart is to speak tenderly, to reassure or win them over (50:21; Hosea 2:14). Dinah herself never speaks in the story.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁכֶ֔ם אֶל־חֲמ֥וֹר אָבִ֖יו לֵאמֹ֑ר קַֽח־לִ֛י אֶת־הַיַּלְדָּ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את לְאִשָּֽׁה׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Shechem to Hamor his father, saying, get for me this girl as a wife.

en.L: And Shechem spoke to Hamor his father, saying, "Get me this girl as a wife."
en.B: So Shechem went to his father Hamor and said, "Arrange for me to marry this girl."
en.R: Shechem told his father Hamor, "I want to marry this girl. Arrange it for me."

es.L: Y habló Siquem a Hamor su padre, diciendo: «Tómame a esta muchacha por mujer».
es.B: Entonces Siquem fue a ver a su padre Hamor y le dijo: «Consígueme a esta muchacha para casarme con ella».
es.R: Siquem le dijo a su padre Hamor: «Quiero casarme con esta muchacha. Arréglalo tú por mí».

fr.L: Et Sichem parla à Hamor son père, en disant : « Prends-moi cette fille pour femme. »
fr.B: Sichem alla donc trouver son père Hamor et lui dit : « Fais en sorte que j’épouse cette fille. »
fr.R: Sichem a dit à son père Hamor : « Je veux épouser cette fille. Arrange cela pour moi. »

sw.L: Shekemu akamwambia Hamori baba yake, akisema, "Nipatie msichana huyu awe mke [wangu]."
sw.B: Basi Shekemu akamwendea baba yake Hamori, akamwambia, "Niposee msichana huyu nimwoe."
sw.R: Shekemu akamwambia baba yake Hamori, "Nataka kumwoa msichana huyu. Nifanyie mpango huo."

decisions.choice: get me this girl: marriage arranged by the fathers
decisions.reason: Marriage was settled between families, so Shechem asks his father to make the arrangements with Dinah's father, as Samson later does (Judges 14:2). His words are blunt: "this girl" (yaldah), not her name.

source.text: וְיַעֲקֹ֣ב שָׁמַ֗ע כִּ֤י טִמֵּא֙ אֶת־דִּינָ֣ה בִתּ֔וֹ וּבָנָ֛יו הָי֥וּ אֶת־מִקְנֵ֖הוּ בַּשָּׂדֶ֑ה וְהֶחֱרִ֥שׁ יַעֲקֹ֖ב עַד־בֹּאָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter, and his sons were with his livestock in the field; and kept silent Jacob until they came.

en.L: And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter; but his sons were with his livestock in the field, so Jacob kept silent until they came.
en.B: Jacob learned that Shechem had defiled his daughter Dinah, but his sons were out in the fields with his herds, so he held his peace until they returned.
en.R: Jacob heard that Shechem had disgraced his daughter Dinah. But his sons were out in the fields with the animals. So Jacob kept quiet until they got back.

es.L: Y Jacob oyó que había mancillado a Dina su hija; pero sus hijos estaban con su ganado en el campo, y Jacob calló hasta que ellos vinieron.
es.B: Jacob se enteró de que Siquem había mancillado a su hija Dina, pero sus hijos estaban en el campo con sus rebaños, así que no dijo nada hasta que volvieron.
es.R: Jacob supo que Siquem había deshonrado a su hija Dina. Pero sus hijos estaban en el campo con los animales. Por eso Jacob se quedó callado hasta que regresaron.

fr.L: Et Jacob apprit qu’il avait souillé Dina sa fille ; or ses fils étaient avec son bétail dans les champs, et Jacob garda le silence jusqu’à ce qu’ils reviennent.
fr.B: Jacob apprit que Sichem avait souillé sa fille Dina, mais ses fils étaient aux champs avec ses troupeaux ; il se tut donc jusqu’à leur retour.
fr.R: Jacob a appris que Sichem avait déshonoré sa fille Dina. Mais ses fils étaient dans les champs avec les bêtes. Alors Jacob n’a rien dit jusqu’à leur retour.

sw.L: Naye Yakobo akasikia kwamba amemtia unajisi Dina binti yake; lakini wanawe walikuwa pamoja na mifugo yake kondeni, naye Yakobo akanyamaza mpaka walipokuja.
sw.B: Yakobo akasikia kwamba Shekemu alikuwa amemtia unajisi binti yake Dina, lakini wanawe walikuwa mashambani pamoja na mifugo yake, kwa hiyo akanyamaza mpaka waliporudi.
sw.R: Yakobo alisikia kwamba Shekemu alikuwa amemwaibisha binti yake Dina. Lakini wanawe walikuwa malishoni na wanyama. Kwa hiyo Yakobo akanyamaza mpaka waliporudi.

decisions.choice: defiled: made unclean, dishonored
decisions.reason: Timme' is the word for making something unclean. Here it means that Dinah has been dishonored and her family shamed. The narrator uses it three times (verses 5, 13, 27).

decisions.choice: Jacob kept silent: his silence is part of the story
decisions.reason: Jacob, the father, says nothing and does nothing until his sons come. His only words in the chapter come at the end, and they are about his own danger (verse 30).

decisions.choice: kumtia unajisi
decisions.reason: "Kutia unajisi" is the Swahili for making something ritually unclean ("najisi", the settled word for "unclean"), so it keeps the force of timme' (m1) and the link with the purity laws. Readable says plainly that he disgraced her ("kumwaibisha"), as the English Readable says "disgraced".

source.text: וַיֵּצֵ֛א חֲמ֥וֹר אֲבִֽי־שְׁכֶ֖ם אֶֽל־יַעֲקֹ֑ב לְדַבֵּ֖ר אִתּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And went out Hamor, father of Shechem, to Jacob to speak with him.

en.L: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out to Jacob to speak with him.
en.B: Meanwhile Hamor, Shechem's father, came out to Jacob to discuss the matter with him.
en.R: Hamor, Shechem's father, came to Jacob to talk things over.

es.L: Y salió Hamor, padre de Siquem, hacia Jacob para hablar con él.
es.B: Mientras tanto, Hamor, el padre de Siquem, fue a ver a Jacob para tratar el asunto con él.
es.R: Hamor, el padre de Siquem, fue a ver a Jacob para hablar del tema.

fr.L: Et Hamor, père de Sichem, sortit vers Jacob pour parler avec lui.
fr.B: Pendant ce temps, Hamor, père de Sichem, sortit trouver Jacob pour discuter de l’affaire avec lui.
fr.R: Hamor, le père de Sichem, est venu voir Jacob pour en discuter.

sw.L: Naye Hamori baba yake Shekemu akatoka kwenda kwa Yakobo kusema naye.
sw.B: Wakati huo Hamori, baba yake Shekemu, akatoka kwenda kwa Yakobo ili kuzungumza naye kuhusu jambo hilo.
sw.R: Hamori, baba yake Shekemu, akaja kwa Yakobo ili wazungumze.

source.text: וּבְנֵ֨י יַעֲקֹ֜ב בָּ֤אוּ מִן־הַשָּׂדֶה֙ כְּשָׁמְעָ֔ם וַיִּֽתְעַצְּבוּ֙ הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים וַיִּ֥חַר לָהֶ֖ם מְאֹ֑ד כִּֽי־נְבָלָ֞ה עָשָׂ֣ה בְיִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לִשְׁכַּב֙ אֶת־בַּֽת־יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְכֵ֖ן לֹ֥א יֵעָשֶֽׂה׃

records.literal_gloss: And the sons of Jacob came from the field when they heard; and were grieved the men, and burned to them exceedingly, for a disgraceful thing he had done in Israel by lying with [the] daughter of Jacob, and so it is not done.

en.L: And the sons of Jacob came in from the field when they heard [it]; and the men were grieved, and they were very angry, because he had done a disgraceful thing in Israel by lying with Jacob's daughter, and such a thing is not done.
en.B: Jacob's sons came in from the fields when they heard the news. They were deeply hurt and burning with anger, for Shechem had done a vile thing in Israel in lying with Jacob's daughter, a deed that is never to be done.
en.R: Jacob's sons heard what had happened and came in from the fields. They were hurt and very angry. Shechem had done a shameful thing to Israel's family by having sex with Jacob's daughter. That kind of thing must never be done.

es.L: Y los hijos de Jacob vinieron del campo cuando lo oyeron; y los hombres se entristecieron y se enojaron mucho, porque había cometido una infamia en Israel al acostarse con la hija de Jacob, y tal cosa no se hace.
es.B: Los hijos de Jacob volvieron del campo en cuanto supieron la noticia. Estaban profundamente dolidos y ardían de ira, porque Siquem había cometido una infamia en Israel al acostarse con la hija de Jacob, algo que jamás debe hacerse.
es.R: Los hijos de Jacob supieron lo que había pasado y volvieron del campo. Estaban dolidos y muy enojados. Siquem había hecho algo vergonzoso contra la familia de Israel al tener relaciones sexuales con la hija de Jacob. Algo así no se debe hacer nunca.

fr.L: Et les fils de Jacob revinrent des champs quand ils [l’]apprirent ; et les hommes furent affligés et très irrités, car il avait commis une infamie en Israël en couchant avec la fille de Jacob, et cela ne se fait pas.
fr.B: Les fils de Jacob rentrèrent des champs dès qu’ils apprirent la nouvelle. Ils étaient profondément blessés et brûlaient de colère, car Sichem avait commis une infamie en Israël en couchant avec la fille de Jacob, une chose qui ne doit jamais se faire.
fr.R: Les fils de Jacob ont appris ce qui s’était passé et sont revenus des champs. Ils étaient blessés et très en colère. Sichem avait fait une chose honteuse contre la famille d’Israël en couchant avec la fille de Jacob. Une telle chose ne doit jamais se faire.

sw.L: Nao wana wa Yakobo wakaja kutoka kondeni waliposikia [habari]; na watu hao wakahuzunika, wakakasirika sana, kwa sababu alikuwa amefanya jambo la aibu katika Israeli kwa kulala na binti Yakobo, na jambo kama hilo halifanywi.
sw.B: Wana wa Yakobo wakarudi kutoka mashambani mara waliposikia habari. Waliumia moyoni na kuwaka hasira, kwa kuwa Shekemu alikuwa amefanya jambo ovu la aibu katika Israeli kwa kulala na binti Yakobo, jambo ambalo halipaswi kufanyika kamwe.
sw.R: Wana wa Yakobo walisikia yaliyotokea, wakarudi kutoka mashambani. Waliumia na kukasirika sana. Shekemu alikuwa ameiaibisha jamaa ya Israeli kwa kufanya ngono na binti Yakobo. Jambo kama hilo halipaswi kufanyika kamwe.

decisions.choice: a disgraceful thing: nevalah, an outrage against the community's moral order
decisions.reason: Nevalah is folly in the moral sense, a shameful deed that breaks the bonds of a people. It is used of the rape of Tamar (2 Samuel 13:12) and the outrage at Gibeah (Judges 19:23; 20:6).

decisions.choice: in Israel: against the family of Israel
decisions.reason: Israel is here the name of the family of Jacob, whom God had just renamed (32:29). The phrase became the standard way to describe a crime that shamed the whole people (Deuteronomy 22:21).

decisions.choice: grieved: hurt and offended
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used of God's grief in 6:6. The brothers feel the deed as an injury to themselves.

decisions.choice: to Israel's family
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that Israel here means Jacob's family, not yet the nation.

source.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר חֲמ֖וֹר אִתָּ֣ם לֵאמֹ֑ר שְׁכֶ֣ם בְּנִ֗י חָֽשְׁקָ֤ה נַפְשׁוֹ֙ בְּבִתְּכֶ֔ם תְּנ֨וּ נָ֥א אֹתָ֛הּ ל֖וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃

records.literal_gloss: And spoke Hamor with them, saying, Shechem my son, his soul longs for your daughter; give her, please, to him as a wife.

en.L: And Hamor spoke with them, saying, "Shechem my son, his soul longs for your daughter. Please give her to him as a wife.
en.B: Hamor talked with them and said, "My son Shechem has given his heart to your daughter. I ask you, let him marry her.
en.R: But Hamor talked with them. He said, "My son Shechem loves your daughter very much. Please let her become his wife.

es.L: Y Hamor habló con ellos, diciendo: «Siquem, mi hijo, su alma anhela a {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} hija. {{plural_you:Dénsela|Dádsela}}, por favor, por mujer.
es.B: Hamor habló con ellos y les dijo: «Mi hijo Siquem ha puesto su corazón en {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} hija. {{plural_you:Les|Os}} ruego que {{plural_you:se la den|se la deis}} por esposa.
es.R: Pero Hamor habló con ellos. Les dijo: «Mi hijo Siquem quiere mucho a {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} hija. Por favor, {{plural_you:permitan|permitid}} que sea su esposa.

fr.L: Et Hamor parla avec eux, en disant : « Sichem, mon fils, son âme est éprise de votre fille ; donnez-la-lui, je vous prie, pour femme.
fr.B: Hamor leur parla ainsi : « Mon fils Sichem s’est attaché de tout son cœur à votre fille. Je vous en prie, laissez-le l’épouser.
fr.R: Mais Hamor leur a parlé. Il leur a dit : « Mon fils Sichem aime beaucoup votre fille. S’il vous plaît, laissez-la devenir sa femme.

sw.L: Naye Hamori akasema nao, akisema, "Shekemu mwanangu, nafsi yake inamtamani binti yenu; tafadhali mpeni awe mke wake.
sw.B: Hamori akazungumza nao, akasema, "Mwanangu Shekemu ameutoa moyo wake kwa binti yenu. Nawaomba, mkubali amwoe.
sw.R: Lakini Hamori akazungumza nao. Akasema, "Mwanangu Shekemu anampenda sana binti yenu. Tafadhali mkubali awe mke wake.

decisions.choice: his soul longs for: he is set on her
decisions.reason: Chashaq means to be bound to or set one's love on someone; Deuteronomy uses it of God's love for Israel (Deuteronomy 7:7). Hamor says nothing about what his son has done.

source.text: וְהִֽתְחַתְּנ֖וּ אֹתָ֑נוּ בְּנֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ תִּתְּנוּ־לָ֔נוּ וְאֶת־בְּנֹתֵ֖ינוּ תִּקְח֥וּ לָכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And intermarry with us; your daughters you will give to us, and our daughters you will take for yourselves.

en.L: And make marriages with us: give your daughters to us, and take our daughters for yourselves.
en.B: Join with us in marriage. You can give your daughters to our men and take our daughters for your own.
en.R: Let our families marry each other. Your daughters can marry our sons, and our daughters can marry your sons.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:emparenten|emparentad}} con nosotros: {{plural_you:dennos|dadnos}} {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} hijas, y {{plural_you:tomen|tomad}} nuestras hijas para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.B: {{plural_you:Únanse|Uníos}} a nosotros por medio del matrimonio. {{plural_you:Pueden|Podéis}} dar {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} hijas a nuestros hombres y tomar nuestras hijas para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.R: Que nuestras familias se casen entre sí. {{plural_you:Sus|Vuestras}} hijas pueden casarse con nuestros hijos, y nuestras hijas con los {{plural_you:suyos|vuestros}}.

fr.L: Et alliez-vous par mariage avec nous : donnez-nous vos filles, et prenez nos filles pour vous.
fr.B: Unissez-vous à nous par des mariages. Vous pourrez donner vos filles à nos hommes et prendre nos filles pour vous.
fr.R: Que nos familles se marient entre elles. Vos filles pourront épouser nos fils, et nos filles épouseront vos fils.

sw.L: Tena oaneni nasi; tupeni binti zenu, nanyi mjitwalie binti zetu.
sw.B: Fanyeni ndoa pamoja nasi. Mnaweza kuwaoza binti zenu kwa wanaume wetu, na kuwaoa binti zetu wawe wake zenu.
sw.R: Familia zetu na zioane. Binti zenu waolewe na wana wetu, na binti zetu waolewe na wana wenu.

decisions.choice: make marriages with us: the joining Abraham's family was to avoid
decisions.reason: Abraham and Isaac had refused Canaanite wives for their sons (24:3; 28:1), and later law forbade such marriages because of the gods they brought (Deuteronomy 7:3-4). Hamor's offer would make Jacob's family one people with the Canaanites (verse 16).

source.text: וְאִתָּ֖נוּ תֵּשֵׁ֑בוּ וְהָאָ֨רֶץ֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה לִפְנֵיכֶ֔ם שְׁבוּ֙ וּסְחָר֔וּהָ וְהֵֽאָחֲז֖וּ בָּֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And with us you will dwell, and the land will be before you; dwell and trade in it and acquire property in it.

en.L: And you will dwell with us, and the land will be open before you. Dwell and trade in it, and get property in it."
en.B: You can live among us. Settle here, move about freely, and buy property of your own; the whole land lies before you."
en.R: You can live here with us. You can go anywhere in the land. Stay here, travel around wherever you want, and buy land for yourselves."

es.L: Y con nosotros {{plural_you:habitarán|habitaréis}}, y la tierra estará abierta delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}; {{plural_you:habiten|habitad}} y {{plural_you:comercien|comerciad}} en ella, y {{plural_you:adquieran|adquirid}} propiedades en ella».
es.B: {{plural_you:Pueden|Podéis}} vivir entre nosotros. {{plural_you:Establézcanse|Estableceos}} aquí, {{plural_you:muévanse|moveos}} libremente y {{plural_you:compren|comprad}} {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} propias tierras; todo el país está a {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} disposición».
es.R: {{plural_you:Pueden|Podéis}} vivir aquí con nosotros. {{plural_you:Pueden|Podéis}} ir a cualquier parte del país. {{plural_you:Quédense|Quedaos}} aquí, {{plural_you:viajen|viajad}} por donde {{plural_you:quieran|queráis}} y {{plural_you:compren|comprad}} tierras para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}».

fr.L: Et vous habiterez avec nous, et le pays sera ouvert devant vous ; habitez-y, circulez-y et acquérez-y des propriétés. »
fr.B: Vous pourrez vivre parmi nous. Établissez-vous ici, allez et venez librement, achetez des terres à vous ; tout le pays est devant vous. »
fr.R: Vous pouvez habiter ici avec nous. Vous pouvez aller partout dans le pays. Restez ici, voyagez où vous voulez et achetez des terres pour vous. »

sw.L: Nanyi mtakaa pamoja nasi, na nchi itakuwa wazi mbele yenu; kaeni, mfanye biashara ndani yake, na mjipatie mali ndani yake."
sw.B: Mnaweza kuishi kati yetu. Kaeni hapa, mzunguke kwa uhuru, mnunue mashamba yenu wenyewe; nchi yote iko mbele yenu."
sw.R: Mnaweza kuishi hapa pamoja nasi. Mnaweza kwenda popote katika nchi hii. Kaeni hapa, safirini popote mnapotaka, na mjinunulie ardhi."

decisions.choice: trade in it: move about freely, or do business
decisions.reason: The verb sachar is used of merchants going about to trade (Ezekiel 27:21), but its basic sense may be simply to go around. Either way, Jacob's family would no longer be outsiders.

decisions.choice: get property in it: what God had promised to give
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for God's promise of the land as a "possession" (17:8). Hamor offers by agreement what God had promised by covenant.

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁכֶם֙ אֶל־אָבִ֣יהוְאֶל־אַחֶ֔יהָ אֶמְצָא־חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינֵיכֶ֑ם וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר תֹּאמְר֛וּ אֵלַ֖י אֶתֵּֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Shechem to her father and to her brothers, let me find favor in your eyes, and what you say to me I will give.

en.L: And Shechem said to her father and to her brothers, "Let me find favor in your eyes, and whatever you say to me I will give.
en.B: Then Shechem spoke up to Dinah's father and brothers: "Be kind to me, and I will pay anything you name.
en.R: Then Shechem spoke to Dinah's father and brothers. "Please agree to this," he said. "I will pay any price you ask.

es.L: Y dijo Siquem al padre de ella y a los hermanos de ella: «Halle yo gracia a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} ojos, y lo que me {{plural_you:digan|digáis}} daré.
es.B: Entonces Siquem se dirigió al padre y a los hermanos de Dina: «{{plural_you:Sean|Sed}} bondadosos conmigo, y pagaré lo que me {{plural_you:pidan|pidáis}}.
es.R: Entonces Siquem habló con el padre y los hermanos de Dina. «Por favor, {{plural_you:acepten|aceptad}} esto —les dijo—. Pagaré el precio que me {{plural_you:pidan|pidáis}}.

fr.L: Et Sichem dit au père et aux frères de celle-ci : « Que je trouve grâce à vos yeux, et ce que vous me direz, je le donnerai.
fr.B: Alors Sichem s’adressa au père et aux frères de Dina : « Soyez bienveillants envers moi, et je paierai tout ce que vous fixerez.
fr.R: Puis Sichem a parlé au père et aux frères de Dina. « S’il vous plaît, acceptez, a-t-il dit. Je paierai le prix que vous demanderez.

sw.L: Naye Shekemu akamwambia baba yake [msichana] na ndugu zake, "Na nipate kibali machoni penu, na lolote mtakaloniambia nitatoa.
sw.B: Kisha Shekemu akawaambia baba na ndugu zake Dina, "Nifanyieni wema, nami nitatoa lolote mtakalotaja.
sw.R: Kisha Shekemu akazungumza na baba na ndugu zake Dina. Akasema, "Tafadhali kubalini jambo hili. Nitalipa bei yoyote mtakayotaka.

decisions.choice: let me find favor in your eyes: please accept my request
decisions.reason: The same polite formula Jacob used with Esau (33:8, 10, 15). Here the one who did the wrong asks for favor.

source.text: הַרְבּ֨וּ עָלַ֤י מְאֹד֙ מֹ֣הַר וּמַתָּ֔ן וְאֶ֨תְּנָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר תֹּאמְר֖וּ אֵלָ֑י וּתְנוּ־לִ֥י אֶת־הַֽנַּעֲרָ֖ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃

records.literal_gloss: Increase on me exceedingly bride-price and gift, and I will give just as you say to me; and give me the girl as a wife.

en.L: Set the bride-price and the gift as high as you like, and I will give whatever you tell me; only give me the young woman as a wife."
en.B: Ask as high a bride-price and as rich a gift as you want, and I will pay whatever you say. Just let me have the girl for my wife."
en.R: Make the bride price and gifts as big as you want. I will pay whatever you say. Just let me marry the girl."

es.L: {{plural_you:Aumenten|Aumentad}} mucho sobre mí el precio por la novia y el regalo, y daré según lo que me {{plural_you:digan|digáis}}; pero {{plural_you:denme|dadme}} a la joven por mujer».
es.B: {{plural_you:Pidan|Pedid}} por la novia un precio tan alto y un regalo tan rico como {{plural_you:quieran|queráis}}, y pagaré lo que me {{plural_you:digan|digáis}}. Solo {{plural_you:déjenme|dejadme}} tomar a la muchacha por esposa».
es.R: {{plural_you:Pidan|Pedid}} por la novia el precio y los regalos que {{plural_you:quieran|queráis}}. Pagaré lo que me {{plural_you:digan|digáis}}. Solo {{plural_you:déjenme|dejadme}} casarme con la muchacha».

fr.L: Augmentez beaucoup à ma charge le prix de la fiancée et le présent, et je donnerai selon ce que vous me direz ; mais donnez-moi la jeune fille pour femme. »
fr.B: Fixez le prix de la fiancée et le présent aussi haut que vous voudrez, et je paierai ce que vous direz. Accordez-moi seulement la jeune fille pour épouse. »
fr.R: Demandez pour la mariée le prix et les cadeaux que vous voulez. Je paierai tout ce que vous direz. Laissez-moi seulement épouser la jeune fille. »

sw.L: Ongezeni sana juu yangu mahari na zawadi, nami nitatoa kama mtakavyoniambia; ila nipeni msichana awe mke [wangu]."
sw.B: Tajeni mahari kubwa na zawadi nyingi kadiri mtakavyo, nami nitalipa chochote mtakachosema. Nipeni tu msichana huyo awe mke wangu."
sw.R: Tajeni mahari na zawadi kubwa kadiri mnavyotaka. Nitalipa chochote mtakachosema. Mniruhusu tu nimwoe msichana huyu."

decisions.choice: bride-price and gift: the payment to the bride's family and gifts at a marriage
decisions.reason: The mohar was paid by the groom to the bride's family. The law later required a man who seduced an unbetrothed girl to pay it and marry her if her father agreed (Exodus 22:16-17; Deuteronomy 22:28-29). The gift (mattan) may have been for the bride herself (24:53).

decisions.choice: el precio por la novia
decisions.reason: The mohar is paid by the groom to the bride's family (m1). Spanish "dote" today means the goods a bride brings to the marriage, the opposite direction, so the payment is described as "el precio por la novia".

decisions.choice: le prix de la fiancée (L, B); le prix pour la mariée (R)
decisions.reason: The mohar is paid by the groom to the bride's family (m1). French "dot" means what a bride brings to the marriage, the opposite direction, so the payment is described as "le prix de la fiancée".

source.text: וַיַּעֲנ֨וּ בְנֵֽי־יַעֲקֹ֜ב אֶת־שְׁכֶ֨ם וְאֶת־חֲמ֥וֹר אָבִ֛יו בְּמִרְמָ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֑רוּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר טִמֵּ֔א אֵ֖ת דִּינָ֥ה אֲחֹתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And answered the sons of Jacob Shechem and Hamor his father with deceit, and they spoke, because he had defiled Dinah their sister.

en.L: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father with deceit, and spoke [so], because he had defiled Dinah their sister.
en.B: Jacob's sons gave Shechem and his father Hamor a deceitful answer, because Shechem had defiled their sister Dinah.
en.R: Jacob's sons answered Shechem and Hamor with a trick. They wanted to pay Shechem back for disgracing their sister Dinah.

es.L: Y respondieron los hijos de Jacob a Siquem y a Hamor su padre con engaño, y hablaron [así], porque había mancillado a Dina su hermana.
es.B: Los hijos de Jacob les dieron a Siquem y a su padre Hamor una respuesta engañosa, porque Siquem había mancillado a su hermana Dina.
es.R: Los hijos de Jacob les respondieron a Siquem y a Hamor con una trampa. Querían vengarse de Siquem por haber deshonrado a su hermana Dina.

fr.L: Et les fils de Jacob répondirent à Sichem et à Hamor son père avec ruse, et ils parlèrent [ainsi], parce qu’il avait souillé Dina leur sœur.
fr.B: Les fils de Jacob donnèrent à Sichem et à son père Hamor une réponse trompeuse, parce que Sichem avait souillé leur sœur Dina.
fr.R: Les fils de Jacob ont répondu à Sichem et à Hamor avec une ruse. Ils voulaient se venger de Sichem, qui avait déshonoré leur sœur Dina.

sw.L: Nao wana wa Yakobo wakamjibu Shekemu na Hamori baba yake kwa hila, wakasema [hivyo], kwa sababu alikuwa amemtia unajisi Dina dada yao.
sw.B: Wana wa Yakobo wakamjibu Shekemu na baba yake Hamori kwa hila, kwa sababu Shekemu alikuwa amemtia unajisi dada yao Dina.
sw.R: Wana wa Yakobo wakawajibu Shekemu na Hamori kwa hila. Walitaka kulipiza kisasi kwa sababu Shekemu alikuwa amemwaibisha dada yao Dina.

decisions.choice: with deceit: the word used of Jacob's own trick
decisions.reason: Mirmah is the word Isaac used when Jacob took Esau's blessing: "your brother came with deceit" (27:35). Jacob's sons now deceive as their father once did.

decisions.choice: They wanted to pay Shechem back
decisions.reason: Readable states the motive that "because" implies: the answer was a plan of revenge.

source.text: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם לֹ֤א נוּכַל֙ לַעֲשׂוֹת֙ הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֔ה לָתֵת֙ אֶת־אֲחֹתֵ֔נוּ לְאִ֖ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ל֣וֹ עָרְלָ֑ה כִּֽי־חֶרְפָּ֥ה הִ֖וא לָֽנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And they said to them, we are not able to do this thing, to give our sister to a man who has a foreskin, for a reproach it [would be] to us.

en.L: And they said to them, "We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to a man who [is] uncircumcised, for that [would be] a disgrace to us.
en.B: They told them, "We cannot do such a thing. To give our sister to a man who is not circumcised would bring shame on us.
en.R: They said, "We cannot let our sister marry a man who is not circumcised. That would bring shame on our family.

es.L: Y les dijeron: «No podemos hacer esto, dar a nuestra hermana a un hombre que [es] incircunciso, porque eso [sería] una deshonra para nosotros.
es.B: Les dijeron: «No podemos hacer tal cosa. Dar a nuestra hermana a un hombre que no está circuncidado sería una vergüenza para nosotros.
es.R: Les dijeron: «No podemos dejar que nuestra hermana se case con un hombre que no está circuncidado. Eso sería una vergüenza para nuestra familia.

fr.L: Et ils leur dirent : « Nous ne pouvons pas faire cette chose, donner notre sœur à un homme qui [est] incirconcis, car ce [serait] un opprobre pour nous.
fr.B: Ils leur dirent : « Nous ne pouvons pas faire une chose pareille. Donner notre sœur à un homme qui n’est pas circoncis serait une honte pour nous.
fr.R: Ils ont dit : « Nous ne pouvons pas laisser notre sœur épouser un homme qui n’est pas circoncis. Ce serait une honte pour notre famille.

sw.L: Wakawaambia, "Hatuwezi kufanya jambo hili, kumpa dada yetu mtu asiyetahiriwa, kwa maana hiyo [ingekuwa] aibu kwetu.
sw.B: Wakawaambia, "Hatuwezi kufanya jambo kama hilo. Kumpa dada yetu mwanamume ambaye hajatahiriwa kungetuletea aibu.
sw.R: Wakasema, "Hatuwezi kumwacha dada yetu aolewe na mwanamume ambaye hajatahiriwa. Hiyo ingeiletea jamaa yetu aibu.

decisions.choice: uncircumcised: outside the covenant sign
decisions.reason: Circumcision was the sign of God's covenant with Abraham's household (17:10-14). The brothers use the sign of the covenant as a weapon, a misuse of something holy.

decisions.choice: uncircumcised
decisions.reason: Literal gives the sense of the Hebrew "who has a foreskin" with the usual English word.

source.text: אַךְ־בְּזֹ֖את נֵא֣וֹת לָכֶ֑ם אִ֚ם תִּהְי֣וּ כָמֹ֔נוּ לְהִמֹּ֥ל לָכֶ֖ם כָּל־זָכָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: Only on this [condition] we will agree to you: if you will be like us, by being circumcised to you every male.

en.L: Only on this [condition] will we agree with you: that you become like us, every male of you being circumcised.
en.B: There is only one way we will consent: you must become as we are, and every male among you must be circumcised.
en.R: There is only one way we will agree. You must be like us: every man and boy among you must be circumcised.

es.L: Solo con esta [condición] {{plural_you:les|os}} daremos nuestro consentimiento: que {{plural_you:lleguen|lleguéis}} a ser como nosotros, circuncidándose todo varón de entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.B: Solo hay una manera en que aceptaremos: {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} ser como nosotros, y todo varón entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} debe ser circuncidado.
es.R: Solo aceptaremos con una condición. {{plural_you:Tienen|Tenéis}} que ser como nosotros: todos los hombres y niños de entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} deben circuncidarse.

fr.L: Seulement à cette [condition] nous consentirons envers vous : que vous deveniez comme nous, en circoncisant tout mâle parmi vous.
fr.B: Nous ne consentirons qu’à une seule condition : que vous deveniez comme nous, et que tout mâle parmi vous soit circoncis.
fr.R: Nous ne serons d’accord qu’à une condition. Vous devez être comme nous : tous les hommes et tous les garçons parmi vous doivent être circoncis.

sw.L: Ila kwa [sharti] hili tu tutakubaliana nanyi: mkiwa kama sisi, kwa kutahiriwa kila mwanamume kwenu.
sw.B: Kuna njia moja tu tutakayokubali: lazima mwe kama sisi, na kila mwanamume kati yenu atahiriwe.
sw.R: Tutakubali kwa sharti moja tu. Lazima mwe kama sisi: kila mwanamume na kila mvulana kati yenu atahiriwe.

source.text: וְנָתַ֤נּוּ אֶת־בְּנֹתֵ֨ינוּ֙ לָכֶ֔ם וְאֶת־בְּנֹתֵיכֶ֖ם נִֽקַּֽח־לָ֑נוּ וְיָשַׁ֣בְנוּ אִתְּכֶ֔ם וְהָיִ֖ינוּ לְעַ֥ם אֶחָֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And we will give our daughters to you, and your daughters we will take for ourselves, and we will dwell with you and we will become one people.

en.L: Then we will give our daughters to you, and we will take your daughters for ourselves, and we will dwell with you and become one people.
en.B: Then we will give you our daughters and take your daughters as wives, and we will live among you as one people.
en.R: Then our daughters can marry your men, and we will marry your daughters. We will live with you, and we will all be one people.

es.L: Entonces {{plural_you:les|os}} daremos nuestras hijas, y tomaremos {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} hijas para nosotros, y habitaremos con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y seremos un solo pueblo.
es.B: Entonces {{plural_you:les|os}} daremos nuestras hijas y tomaremos a las {{plural_you:suyas|vuestras}} por esposas, y viviremos entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} como un solo pueblo.
es.R: Entonces nuestras hijas podrán casarse con {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} hombres, y nosotros nos casaremos con {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} hijas. Viviremos con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y seremos todos un solo pueblo.

fr.L: Alors nous vous donnerons nos filles, et nous prendrons vos filles pour nous, et nous habiterons avec vous et nous deviendrons un seul peuple.
fr.B: Alors nous vous donnerons nos filles et nous prendrons vos filles pour épouses, et nous vivrons parmi vous comme un seul peuple.
fr.R: Alors nos filles pourront épouser vos hommes, et nous épouserons vos filles. Nous vivrons avec vous, et nous serons tous un seul peuple.

sw.L: Ndipo tutawapa binti zetu, nasi tutajitwalia binti zenu, nasi tutakaa pamoja nanyi na kuwa watu wamoja.
sw.B: Ndipo tutawapa binti zetu na kuwaoa binti zenu, nasi tutaishi kati yenu kama watu wamoja.
sw.R: Ndipo binti zetu wataweza kuolewa na wanaume wenu, nasi tutawaoa binti zenu. Tutaishi pamoja nanyi, na sote tutakuwa watu wamoja.

source.text: וְאִם־לֹ֧א תִשְׁמְע֛וּ אֵלֵ֖ינוּ לְהִמּ֑וֹל וְלָקַ֥חְנוּ אֶת־בִּתֵּ֖נוּ וְהָלָֽכְנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And if you will not listen to us to be circumcised, then we will take our daughter and we will go.

en.L: But if you will not listen to us and be circumcised, then we will take our daughter and go."
en.B: But if you refuse to be circumcised as we ask, we will take our daughter and be on our way."
en.R: But if you will not be circumcised, we will take our sister back and move on."

es.L: Pero si no nos {{plural_you:escuchan|escucháis}} para {{plural_you:circuncidarse|circuncidaros}}, entonces tomaremos a nuestra hija y nos iremos».
es.B: Pero si {{plural_you:se niegan a circuncidarse|os negáis a circuncidaros}} como {{plural_you:les|os}} pedimos, tomaremos a nuestra hija y seguiremos nuestro camino».
es.R: Pero si no {{plural_you:se circuncidan|os circuncidáis}}, tomaremos a nuestra hermana y nos iremos de aquí».

fr.L: Mais si vous ne nous écoutez pas pour être circoncis, alors nous prendrons notre fille et nous nous en irons. »
fr.B: Mais si vous refusez de vous faire circoncire comme nous le demandons, nous prendrons notre fille et nous reprendrons la route. »
fr.R: Mais si vous ne voulez pas être circoncis, nous reprendrons notre sœur et nous partirons. »

sw.L: Lakini msipotusikiliza kutahiriwa, basi tutamchukua binti yetu na kwenda zetu."
sw.B: Lakini mkikataa kutahiriwa kama tunavyowaomba, tutamchukua binti yetu na kwenda zetu."
sw.R: Lakini msipotahiriwa, tutamchukua dada yetu na kuondoka."

decisions.choice: our daughter: Dinah, spoken of as the family's daughter
decisions.reason: The brothers speak for the family as a whole, so they say "our daughter". Their words also show that Dinah was still in Shechem's house (verse 26).

decisions.choice: our sister
decisions.reason: Readable says "sister" so that a reader does not take Dinah for the brothers' own child.

source.text: וַיִּֽיטְב֥וּ דִבְרֵיהֶ֖ם בְּעֵינֵ֣י חֲמ֑וֹר וּבְעֵינֵ֖י שְׁכֶ֥ם בֶּן־חֲמֽוֹר׃

records.literal_gloss: And were good their words in [the] eyes of Hamor and in [the] eyes of Shechem, son of Hamor.

en.L: And their words pleased Hamor and Shechem, Hamor's son.
en.B: Hamor and his son Shechem liked what they heard.
en.R: Hamor and his son Shechem thought this was a good plan.

es.L: Y sus palabras agradaron a Hamor y a Siquem, hijo de Hamor.
es.B: A Hamor y a su hijo Siquem les pareció bien lo que oyeron.
es.R: Hamor y su hijo Siquem pensaron que era un buen plan.

fr.L: Et leurs paroles plurent à Hamor et à Sichem, fils de Hamor.
fr.B: Hamor et son fils Sichem trouvèrent bon ce qu’ils entendaient.
fr.R: Hamor et son fils Sichem ont trouvé que c’était une bonne idée.

sw.L: Na maneno yao yakawa mema machoni pa Hamori na machoni pa Shekemu mwana wa Hamori.
sw.B: Hamori na mwanawe Shekemu wakaridhika na waliyoyasikia.
sw.R: Hamori na mwanawe Shekemu waliona kwamba huo ulikuwa mpango mzuri.

source.text: וְלֹֽא־אֵחַ֤ר הַנַּ֨עַר֙ לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת הַדָּבָ֔ר כִּ֥י חָפֵ֖ץ בְּבַֽת־יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְה֣וּא נִכְבָּ֔ד מִכֹּ֖ל בֵּ֥ית אָבִֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And did not delay the young man to do the thing, for he delighted in [the] daughter of Jacob; and he [was] honored more than all [the] house of his father.

en.L: And the young man did not delay to do the thing, because he delighted in Jacob's daughter. And he [was] honored above all his father's house.
en.B: The young man did not wait to carry out the condition, so taken was he with Jacob's daughter. He was the most respected person in his whole family.
en.R: Shechem wanted Jacob's daughter so much that he did what they asked right away. He was the most important man in his father's family.

es.L: Y no tardó el joven en hacer la cosa, porque se deleitaba en la hija de Jacob. Y él [era] el más honrado de toda la casa de su padre.
es.B: El joven no perdió tiempo en cumplir la condición, tan prendado estaba de la hija de Jacob. Era la persona más respetada de toda su familia.
es.R: Siquem deseaba tanto a la hija de Jacob que enseguida hizo lo que le pidieron. Era el hombre más importante de la familia de su padre.

fr.L: Et le jeune homme ne tarda pas à faire la chose, car il aimait la fille de Jacob. Et il [était] honoré plus que toute la maison de son père.
fr.B: Le jeune homme ne tarda pas à remplir la condition, tant il était épris de la fille de Jacob. Il était le plus respecté de toute sa famille.
fr.R: Sichem désirait tellement la fille de Jacob qu’il a fait tout de suite ce qu’on lui demandait. C’était l’homme le plus important de la famille de son père.

sw.L: Wala kijana hakukawia kulifanya jambo hilo, kwa sababu alipendezwa na binti Yakobo. Naye [alikuwa] mwenye kuheshimiwa kuliko wote wa nyumba ya baba yake.
sw.B: Kijana huyo hakukawia kutimiza sharti hilo, kwa jinsi alivyopendezwa na binti Yakobo. Yeye ndiye aliyeheshimiwa kuliko wote katika jamaa yake.
sw.R: Shekemu alimtaka binti Yakobo sana hata akafanya walichoomba mara moja. Alikuwa mtu muhimu kuliko wote katika jamaa ya baba yake.

decisions.choice: honored above all his father's house: the most respected of the family
decisions.reason: Because Shechem was so respected, his word would carry the men of the city with him (verses 20-24).

source.text: וַיָּבֹ֥א חֲמ֛וֹר וּשְׁכֶ֥ם בְּנ֖וֹ אֶל־שַׁ֣עַר עִירָ֑ם וַֽיְדַבְּר֛וּ אֶל־אַנְשֵׁ֥י עִירָ֖ם לֵאמֹֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And came Hamor and Shechem his son to [the] gate of their city, and they spoke to [the] men of their city, saying,

en.L: And Hamor and Shechem his son came to the gate of their city, and spoke to the men of their city, saying,
en.B: So Hamor and his son Shechem went to the city gate and addressed the men of the town.
en.R: So Hamor and his son Shechem went to the meeting place at the city gate. They spoke to the men of their city.

es.L: Y vinieron Hamor y Siquem su hijo a la puerta de su ciudad, y hablaron a los hombres de su ciudad, diciendo:
es.B: Entonces Hamor y su hijo Siquem fueron a la puerta de la ciudad y hablaron a los hombres del pueblo.
es.R: Entonces Hamor y su hijo Siquem fueron al lugar de reunión junto a la puerta de la ciudad. Hablaron con los hombres de su ciudad.

fr.L: Et Hamor et Sichem son fils vinrent à la porte de leur ville, et parlèrent aux hommes de leur ville, en disant :
fr.B: Hamor et son fils Sichem se rendirent donc à la porte de la ville et parlèrent aux hommes de la cité.
fr.R: Alors Hamor et son fils Sichem sont allés au lieu de réunion, à la porte de la ville. Ils ont parlé aux hommes de leur ville.

sw.L: Basi Hamori na Shekemu mwanawe wakaja langoni mwa mji wao, wakasema na watu wa mji wao, wakisema,
sw.B: Basi Hamori na mwanawe Shekemu wakaenda kwenye lango la mji, wakawahutubia watu wa mji.
sw.R: Basi Hamori na mwanawe Shekemu wakaenda mahali pa mikutano penye lango la mji. Wakazungumza na wanaume wa mji wao.

decisions.choice: the gate of their city: the place of public business
decisions.reason: The open space inside a city gate was where the leading men met to decide matters, as Abraham bought his field "at the gate" of Hebron (23:10, 18).

decisions.choice: the meeting place at
decisions.reason: Readable adds what the gate was used for.

source.text: הָאֲנָשִׁ֨ים הָאֵ֜לֶּה שְֽׁלֵמִ֧ים הֵ֣ם אִתָּ֗נוּ וְיֵשְׁב֤וּ בָאָ֨רֶץ֙ וְיִסְחֲר֣וּ אֹתָ֔הּ וְהָאָ֛רֶץ הִנֵּ֥ה רַֽחֲבַת־יָדַ֖יִם לִפְנֵיהֶ֑ם אֶת־בְּנֹתָם֙ נִקַּֽח־לָ֣נוּ לְנָשִׁ֔ים וְאֶת־בְּנֹתֵ֖ינוּ נִתֵּ֥ן לָהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: These men, at peace they [are] with us; and let them dwell in the land and trade in it; and the land, behold, [is] broad on both hands before them; their daughters we will take for ourselves as wives, and our daughters we will give to them.

en.L: "These men [are] at peace with us. Let them dwell in the land and trade in it, for the land, look, [is] wide enough on both sides for them. Let us take their daughters for ourselves as wives, and give our daughters to them.
en.B: "These people mean us no harm," they said. "Let them live here and do business in the land; there is room enough and to spare for them. We can take their daughters as wives and give them our daughters.
en.R: "These men are peaceful toward us," they said. "Let them live and travel in our land. The land is big enough for all of us. Our men can take their daughters as wives, and their men can take ours.

es.L: «Estos hombres [están] en paz con nosotros; que habiten en la tierra y comercien en ella, pues la tierra, {{plural_you:miren|mirad}}, [es] amplia por ambos lados delante de ellos. Tomemos sus hijas para nosotros por mujeres, y démosles nuestras hijas.
es.B: «Esta gente no nos quiere ningún mal —dijeron—. Dejemos que vivan aquí y hagan negocios en el país; hay tierra de sobra para ellos. Podemos tomar a sus hijas por esposas y darles a nuestras hijas.
es.R: «Estos hombres son pacíficos con nosotros —dijeron—. Dejemos que vivan en nuestra tierra y viajen por ella. La tierra es lo bastante grande para todos. Nuestros hombres pueden casarse con sus hijas, y sus hombres con las nuestras.

fr.L: « Ces hommes [sont] en paix avec nous. Qu’ils habitent dans le pays et y circulent, car le pays, voici, [est] assez large de tous côtés pour eux. Prenons leurs filles pour nous comme femmes, et donnons-leur nos filles.
fr.B: « Ces gens ne nous veulent aucun mal, dirent-ils. Qu’ils s’installent ici et fassent du commerce dans le pays ; il y a largement de la place pour eux. Nous pourrons prendre leurs filles pour femmes et leur donner nos filles.
fr.R: « Ces hommes sont pacifiques envers nous, ont-ils dit. Laissons-les habiter et voyager dans notre pays. Le pays est assez grand pour tout le monde. Nos hommes pourront épouser leurs filles, et leurs hommes épouseront les nôtres.

sw.L: "Watu hawa [wana] amani nasi; basi na wakae katika nchi na kufanya biashara ndani yake, kwa maana nchi, tazama, [ni] pana pande zote mbele yao; na tuwatwae binti zao wawe wake zetu, na kuwapa binti zetu.
sw.B: "Watu hawa hawana nia mbaya nasi," wakasema. "Na waishi hapa na kufanya biashara katika nchi hii; nafasi ipo ya kutosha na kuzidi kwa ajili yao. Tunaweza kuwaoa binti zao na kuwaoza binti zetu kwao.
sw.R: "Watu hawa ni wa amani kwetu," wakasema. "Na waishi na kusafiri katika nchi yetu. Nchi ni kubwa ya kututosha sote. Wanaume wetu wanaweza kuwaoa binti zao, na wanaume wao wawaoe binti zetu.

decisions.choice: at peace: shelemim, the word used of Jacob's safe arrival
decisions.reason: Jacob arrived at Shechem shalem, "safely" or "in peace" (33:18). The city takes the newcomers as people of peace, unaware of what is planned.

decisions.choice: broad on both hands: wide in every direction
decisions.reason: The land has room on the right and on the left, room enough for all.

source.text: אַךְ־בְּ֠זֹאת יֵאֹ֨תוּ לָ֤נוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים֙ לָשֶׁ֣בֶת אִתָּ֔נוּ לִהְי֖וֹת לְעַ֣ם אֶחָ֑ד בְּהִמּ֥וֹל לָ֨נוּ֙ כָּל־זָכָ֔ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר הֵ֥ם נִמֹּלִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Only on this [condition] will agree to us the men to dwell with us, to become one people: when is circumcised to us every male, as they [are] circumcised.

en.L: Only on this [condition] will the men agree with us to dwell with us and become one people: that every male among us be circumcised, as they [are] circumcised.
en.B: But there is one condition before the men will consent to live with us and become one people: every male among us has to be circumcised, just as they are.
en.R: But they will only agree to live with us and become one people if all our men and boys are circumcised, as theirs are.

es.L: Solo con esta [condición] consentirán los hombres en habitar con nosotros, para ser un solo pueblo: que se circuncide todo varón entre nosotros, como ellos [están] circuncidados.
es.B: Pero hay una condición para que estos hombres acepten vivir con nosotros y formar un solo pueblo: todo varón entre nosotros tiene que circuncidarse, igual que ellos.
es.R: Pero solo aceptarán vivir con nosotros y ser un solo pueblo si todos nuestros hombres y niños se circuncidan, como ellos.

fr.L: Seulement à cette [condition] ces hommes consentiront à habiter avec nous pour devenir un seul peuple : que tout mâle parmi nous soit circoncis, comme eux-mêmes [sont] circoncis.
fr.B: Mais il y a une condition pour que ces hommes acceptent de vivre avec nous et de former un seul peuple : tout mâle parmi nous doit être circoncis, comme ils le sont eux-mêmes.
fr.R: Mais ils n’accepteront de vivre avec nous et d’être un seul peuple que si tous nos hommes et tous nos garçons sont circoncis, comme les leurs.

sw.L: Ila kwa [sharti] hili tu watu hawa watakubaliana nasi kukaa pamoja nasi, kuwa watu wamoja: kila mwanamume kwetu akitahiriwa, kama wao walivyotahiriwa.
sw.B: Lakini kuna sharti moja kabla watu hawa hawajakubali kuishi pamoja nasi na kuwa watu wamoja: kila mwanamume kati yetu lazima atahiriwe, kama wao walivyo.
sw.R: Lakini watakubali kuishi pamoja nasi na kuwa watu wamoja ikiwa tu wanaume na wavulana wetu wote watatahiriwa, kama wao.

source.text: מִקְנֵהֶ֤ם וְקִנְיָנָם֙ וְכָל־בְּהֶמְתָּ֔ם הֲל֥וֹא לָ֖נוּ הֵ֑ם אַ֚ךְ נֵא֣וֹתָה לָהֶ֔ם וְיֵשְׁב֖וּ אִתָּֽנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Their livestock and their property and all their animals, not ours will they [be]? Only let us agree to them, and they will dwell with us.

en.L: Their livestock and their property and all their animals, will they not [be] ours? Only let us agree with them, and they will dwell with us."
en.B: Think of it: their herds, their goods and all their animals will end up belonging to us. We have only to say yes to them, and they will make their home with us."
en.R: And then all their cattle, their things and their other animals will become ours! So let us say yes, and they will live here with us."

es.L: Su ganado y sus bienes y todas sus bestias, ¿no [serán] nuestros? Solamente consintamos con ellos, y habitarán con nosotros».
es.B: {{plural_you:Piénsenlo|Pensadlo}}: sus rebaños, sus bienes y todos sus animales acabarán siendo nuestros. Solo tenemos que decirles que sí, y se quedarán a vivir con nosotros».
es.R: ¡Y entonces todo su ganado, sus cosas y sus demás animales serán nuestros! Así que digámosles que sí, y vivirán aquí con nosotros».

fr.L: Leur bétail, leurs biens et toutes leurs bêtes ne [seront]-ils pas à nous ? Donnons-leur seulement notre accord, et ils habiteront avec nous. »
fr.B: Pensez-y : leurs troupeaux, leurs biens et toutes leurs bêtes finiront par nous appartenir. Nous n’avons qu’à leur dire oui, et ils s’établiront chez nous. »
fr.R: Et alors, tout leur bétail, toutes leurs affaires et toutes leurs autres bêtes seront à nous ! Alors disons oui, et ils habiteront ici avec nous. »

sw.L: Mifugo yao na mali zao na wanyama wao wote, je, hawatakuwa wetu? Ila tukubaliane nao tu, nao watakaa pamoja nasi."
sw.B: Fikirini: makundi yao, mali zao na wanyama wao wote watakuwa wetu. Tunahitaji tu kuwakubalia, nao wataishi pamoja nasi."
sw.R: Kisha ng'ombe wao wote, vitu vyao na wanyama wao wengine watakuwa wetu! Basi tuwakubalie, nao wataishi hapa pamoja nasi."

decisions.choice: will they not be ours?: the motive kept from Jacob's family
decisions.reason: Hamor and Shechem tell their own men what they did not tell Jacob: the union will bring Jacob's wealth into the city. Both sides now hide their real aims.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁמְע֤וּ אֶל־חֲמוֹר֙ וְאֶל־שְׁכֶ֣ם בְּנ֔וֹ כָּל־יֹצְאֵ֖י שַׁ֣עַר עִיר֑וֹ וַיִּמֹּ֨לוּ֙ כָּל־זָכָ֔ר כָּל־יֹצְאֵ֖י שַׁ֥עַר עִירֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And listened to Hamor and to Shechem his son all who went out [at the] gate of his city, and were circumcised every male, all who went out [at the] gate of his city.

en.L: And all who went out of the gate of his city listened to Hamor and to Shechem his son, and every male was circumcised, all who went out of the gate of his city.
en.B: All the men who went in and out of the city gate agreed with Hamor and his son Shechem, and every male of the town, every one of those men, was circumcised.
en.R: All the men of the city agreed with Hamor and his son Shechem. So every male in the city was circumcised.

es.L: Y escucharon a Hamor y a Siquem su hijo todos los que salían por la puerta de su ciudad, y fue circuncidado todo varón, todos los que salían por la puerta de su ciudad.
es.B: Todos los hombres que entraban y salían por la puerta de la ciudad estuvieron de acuerdo con Hamor y con su hijo Siquem, y todo varón del pueblo, cada uno de aquellos hombres, fue circuncidado.
es.R: Todos los hombres de la ciudad estuvieron de acuerdo con Hamor y su hijo Siquem. Así que todos los varones de la ciudad se circuncidaron.

fr.L: Et tous ceux qui sortaient par la porte de sa ville écoutèrent Hamor et Sichem son fils, et tout mâle fut circoncis, tous ceux qui sortaient par la porte de sa ville.
fr.B: Tous les hommes qui passaient par la porte de la ville se rangèrent à l’avis de Hamor et de son fils Sichem, et tout mâle de la cité, chacun de ces hommes, fut circoncis.
fr.R: Tous les hommes de la ville ont été d’accord avec Hamor et son fils Sichem. Ainsi, tous les hommes et les garçons de la ville ont été circoncis.

sw.L: Na wote waliotoka langoni mwa mji wake wakamsikiliza Hamori na Shekemu mwanawe, na kila mwanamume akatahiriwa, wote waliotoka langoni mwa mji wake.
sw.B: Wanaume wote waliopita katika lango la mji wakakubaliana na Hamori na mwanawe Shekemu, na kila mwanamume wa mji ule, kila mmoja wao, akatahiriwa.
sw.R: Wanaume wote wa mji wakakubaliana na Hamori na mwanawe Shekemu. Basi kila mwanamume katika mji akatahiriwa.

decisions.choice: all who went out of the gate of his city: all the men of the city
decisions.reason: The phrase describes the full male citizens who took part in the city's public life and its defense. The repetition stresses that not one of them was left out.

source.text: וַיְהִי֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֜י בִּֽהְיוֹתָ֣ם כֹּֽאֲבִ֗ים וַיִּקְח֣וּ שְׁנֵֽי־בְנֵי־יַ֠עֲקֹב שִׁמְע֨וֹן וְלֵוִ֜י אֲחֵ֤י דִינָה֙ אִ֣ישׁ חַרְבּ֔וֹ וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ עַל־הָעִ֖יר בֶּ֑טַח וַיַּֽהַרְג֖וּ כָּל־זָכָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was on the third day, when they were in pain, and took two of [the] sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, [the] brothers of Dinah, each his sword, and they came on the city securely and killed every male.

en.L: And it happened on the third day, when they were in pain, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah's brothers, each took his sword and came upon the city unopposed, and killed every male.
en.B: On the third day, while the men were still sore, two of Jacob's sons, Simeon and Levi, Dinah's full brothers, took up their swords. They walked into the city without any resistance and put every male to death.
en.R: On the third day, all the men in the city were still sore and weak. Then Simeon and Levi, two of Jacob's sons, took their swords. They were Dinah's brothers. They walked into the city without anyone stopping them and killed every man.

es.L: Y sucedió al tercer día, cuando ellos estaban doloridos, que dos de los hijos de Jacob, Simeón y Leví, hermanos de Dina, tomaron cada uno su espada, vinieron sobre la ciudad sin oposición y mataron a todo varón.
es.B: Al tercer día, cuando los hombres todavía estaban doloridos, dos de los hijos de Jacob, Simeón y Leví, hermanos de Dina por parte de padre y madre, tomaron sus espadas. Entraron en la ciudad sin encontrar resistencia y mataron a todos los varones.
es.R: Al tercer día, todos los hombres de la ciudad seguían doloridos y débiles. Entonces Simeón y Leví, dos de los hijos de Jacob, tomaron sus espadas. Eran hermanos de Dina. Entraron en la ciudad sin que nadie los detuviera y mataron a todos los hombres.

fr.L: Et il arriva, le troisième jour, alors qu’ils étaient dans la douleur, que deux des fils de Jacob, Siméon et Lévi, frères de Dina, prirent chacun son épée, vinrent sur la ville sans rencontrer d’opposition et tuèrent tous les mâles.
fr.B: Le troisième jour, alors que les hommes souffraient encore, deux des fils de Jacob, Siméon et Lévi, frères de Dina par le père et par la mère, prirent leurs épées. Ils entrèrent dans la ville sans rencontrer de résistance et mirent à mort tous les mâles.
fr.R: Le troisième jour, tous les hommes de la ville avaient encore mal et étaient faibles. Alors Siméon et Lévi, deux des fils de Jacob, ont pris leurs épées. C’étaient les frères de Dina. Ils sont entrés dans la ville sans que personne les arrête et ont tué tous les hommes.

sw.L: Ikawa siku ya tatu, walipokuwa na maumivu, wana wawili wa Yakobo, Simeoni na Lawi, ndugu zake Dina, wakachukua kila mtu upanga wake, wakauvamia mji bila kupingwa, wakamuua kila mwanamume.
sw.B: Siku ya tatu, wanaume wale walipokuwa bado na maumivu, wana wawili wa Yakobo, Simeoni na Lawi, ndugu wa tumbo moja na Dina, wakachukua panga zao. Wakaingia mjini bila upinzani wowote, wakawaua wanaume wote.
sw.R: Siku ya tatu, wanaume wote wa mji walikuwa bado na maumivu na udhaifu. Ndipo Simeoni na Lawi, wana wawili wa Yakobo, wakachukua panga zao. Hao walikuwa ndugu zake Dina. Wakaingia mjini bila mtu yeyote kuwazuia, wakawaua wanaume wote.

decisions.choice: securely: the city was unsuspecting, or the brothers met no resistance
decisions.reason: Betach means safety or confidence. It may describe the city, sure of its new peace, or the brothers, who could walk in without danger.

decisions.choice: Simeon and Levi, Dinah's brothers: her full brothers, sons of Leah
decisions.reason: All three were children of Leah (29:33-34; 30:21), so these two take on the duty of defending her honor. Jacob later condemns their violence in his last words (49:5-7).

source.text: וְאֶת־חֲמוֹר֙ וְאֶת־שְׁכֶ֣ם בְּנ֔וֹ הָרְג֖וּ לְפִי־חָ֑רֶב וַיִּקְח֧וּ אֶת־דִּינָ֛ה מִבֵּ֥ית שְׁכֶ֖ם וַיֵּצֵֽאוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And Hamor and Shechem his son they killed by [the] mouth of [the] sword, and they took Dinah from [the] house of Shechem and went out.

en.L: And they killed Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem's house and went away.
en.B: Hamor and his son Shechem they struck down with the sword. Then they brought Dinah out of Shechem's house and went away.
en.R: They killed Hamor and his son Shechem with their swords. Then they took Dinah out of Shechem's house and left.

es.L: Y a Hamor y a Siquem su hijo mataron a filo de espada, y tomaron a Dina de la casa de Siquem y salieron.
es.B: A Hamor y a su hijo Siquem los mataron a espada. Luego sacaron a Dina de la casa de Siquem y se marcharon.
es.R: Mataron a Hamor y a su hijo Siquem con sus espadas. Después sacaron a Dina de la casa de Siquem y se fueron.

fr.L: Et ils tuèrent Hamor et Sichem son fils au tranchant de l’épée, prirent Dina de la maison de Sichem et sortirent.
fr.B: Ils abattirent Hamor et son fils Sichem par l’épée. Puis ils firent sortir Dina de la maison de Sichem et s’en allèrent.
fr.R: Ils ont tué Hamor et son fils Sichem avec leurs épées. Puis ils ont fait sortir Dina de la maison de Sichem et ils sont partis.

sw.L: Wakamuua Hamori na Shekemu mwanawe kwa makali ya upanga, wakamchukua Dina kutoka nyumba ya Shekemu, wakatoka.
sw.B: Wakawaua Hamori na mwanawe Shekemu kwa upanga. Kisha wakamtoa Dina katika nyumba ya Shekemu, wakaondoka.
sw.R: Wakawaua Hamori na mwanawe Shekemu kwa panga zao. Kisha wakamtoa Dina katika nyumba ya Shekemu, wakaondoka.

decisions.choice: the mouth of the sword: the sword's edge
decisions.reason: A sword was said to "eat" (2 Samuel 2:26), so its edge is its "mouth". The phrase means to kill without mercy.

decisions.choice: took Dinah from Shechem's house: she had been kept there
decisions.reason: Dinah had been in Shechem's house all through the bargaining.

source.text: בְּנֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֗ב בָּ֚אוּ עַל־הַ֣חֲלָלִ֔ים וַיָּבֹ֖זּוּ הָעִ֑יר אֲשֶׁ֥ר טִמְּא֖וּ אֲחוֹתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: The sons of Jacob came on the slain and plundered the city, because they had defiled their sister.

en.L: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain and plundered the city, because they had defiled their sister.
en.B: The rest of Jacob's sons came over the bodies of the dead and looted the city, since it was there their sister had been defiled.
en.R: Then the other sons of Jacob came. They walked past the dead bodies and robbed the city, because their sister had been disgraced there.

es.L: Los hijos de Jacob vinieron sobre los muertos y saquearon la ciudad, porque habían mancillado a su hermana.
es.B: Los demás hijos de Jacob pasaron sobre los cadáveres y saquearon la ciudad, pues allí había sido mancillada su hermana.
es.R: Luego llegaron los otros hijos de Jacob. Pasaron junto a los cadáveres y robaron todo en la ciudad, porque allí habían deshonrado a su hermana.

fr.L: Les fils de Jacob vinrent sur les tués et pillèrent la ville, parce qu’ils avaient souillé leur sœur.
fr.B: Les autres fils de Jacob passèrent sur les cadavres et pillèrent la ville, puisque c’était là que leur sœur avait été souillée.
fr.R: Ensuite, les autres fils de Jacob sont arrivés. Ils sont passés à côté des morts et ont pillé la ville, parce que leur sœur y avait été déshonorée.

sw.L: Wana wa Yakobo wakawajia waliouawa, wakaupora mji, kwa sababu walikuwa wamemtia unajisi dada yao.
sw.B: Wana wengine wa Yakobo wakapita juu ya maiti, wakaupora mji, kwa kuwa ndimo dada yao alimotiwa unajisi.
sw.R: Kisha wana wengine wa Yakobo wakaja. Wakapita karibu na maiti, wakaupora mji, kwa sababu dada yao alikuwa ameaibishwa humo.

decisions.choice: the sons of Jacob: the other brothers join in
decisions.reason: Simeon and Levi did the killing; now the sons of Jacob in general share in the looting. The text does not say which of them took part.

decisions.choice: they had defiled: the whole city is held guilty
decisions.reason: The verb is plural: the brothers blame the whole city, not only Shechem, for what was done to Dinah.

decisions.choice: the rest of Jacob's sons (B); the other sons of Jacob (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make clear that these are the other brothers, as the change from Simeon and Levi to "the sons of Jacob" suggests.

source.text: אֶת־צֹאנָ֥ם וְאֶת־בְּקָרָ֖ם וְאֶת־חֲמֹרֵיהֶּ֑םוְאֵ֧ת אֲשֶׁר־בָּעִ֛יר וְאֶת־אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּשָּׂדֶ֖ה לָקָֽחוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Their flocks and their herds and their donkeys and what [was] in the city and what [was] in the field they took.

en.L: They took their flocks and their herds and their donkeys, and whatever [was] in the city and whatever [was] in the field.
en.B: They carried off their sheep and goats, their cattle and their donkeys, everything in the town and in the countryside.
en.R: They took all their sheep, goats, cattle and donkeys. They took everything in the city and in the fields.

es.L: Tomaron sus ovejas y sus vacas y sus asnos, y lo que [había] en la ciudad y lo que [había] en el campo.
es.B: Se llevaron sus ovejas y cabras, sus vacas y sus burros, todo lo que había en el pueblo y en el campo.
es.R: Se llevaron todas sus ovejas, cabras, vacas y burros. Se llevaron todo lo que había en la ciudad y en los campos.

fr.L: Ils prirent leurs moutons, leurs bœufs et leurs ânes, et ce qui [était] dans la ville et ce qui [était] dans les champs.
fr.B: Ils emmenèrent leurs moutons et leurs chèvres, leurs bœufs et leurs ânes, tout ce qui se trouvait dans la ville et dans la campagne.
fr.R: Ils ont pris tous leurs moutons, leurs chèvres, leurs bœufs et leurs ânes. Ils ont pris tout ce qu’il y avait dans la ville et dans les champs.

sw.L: Wakachukua kondoo zao na ng'ombe zao na punda zao, na kilichokuwa mjini na kilichokuwa kondeni.
sw.B: Wakachukua kondoo na mbuzi wao, ng'ombe wao na punda wao, kila kitu kilichokuwa mjini na mashambani.
sw.R: Wakachukua kondoo, mbuzi, ng'ombe na punda wao wote. Wakachukua kila kitu kilichokuwa mjini na mashambani.

decisions.choice: their flocks, their herds and their donkeys: the wealth the city had hoped to gain
decisions.reason: The men of the city had said, "Will their livestock not be ours?" (verse 23). Instead their own livestock is taken.

source.text: וְאֶת־כָּל־חֵילָ֤ם וְאֶת־כָּל־טַפָּם֙ וְאֶת־נְשֵׁיהֶ֔ם שָׁב֖וּ וַיָּבֹ֑זּוּ וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּבָּֽיִת׃

records.literal_gloss: And all their wealth and all their little ones and their wives they took captive, and they plundered, and all that [was] in the house.

en.L: And all their wealth and all their little ones and their wives they took captive and plundered, and all that [was] in the houses.
en.B: All their goods, all their little children and their wives they took as captives and loot, along with everything inside the houses.
en.R: They took everything the people owned. They captured all the women and children. They took everything in the houses.

es.L: Y toda su riqueza, y a todos sus pequeños y a sus mujeres, llevaron cautivos y saquearon, y todo lo que [había] en las casas.
es.B: Se llevaron como cautivos y botín todos sus bienes, a todos sus niños pequeños y a sus mujeres, junto con todo lo que había dentro de las casas.
es.R: Se llevaron todo lo que la gente tenía. Capturaron a todas las mujeres y a los niños. Se llevaron todo lo que había en las casas.

fr.L: Et toutes leurs richesses, et tous leurs petits enfants et leurs femmes, ils les emmenèrent captifs et les pillèrent, et tout ce qui [était] dans les maisons.
fr.B: Ils emmenèrent comme captifs et comme butin tous leurs biens, tous leurs petits enfants et leurs femmes, ainsi que tout ce qui se trouvait dans les maisons.
fr.R: Ils ont pris tout ce que les gens possédaient. Ils ont capturé toutes les femmes et tous les enfants. Ils ont pris tout ce qu’il y avait dans les maisons.

sw.L: Na mali yao yote na watoto wao wadogo wote na wake zao wakawateka, wakapora, na vyote vilivyokuwa nyumbani.
sw.B: Wakateka na kupora mali yao yote, watoto wao wadogo wote na wake zao, pamoja na kila kitu kilichokuwa ndani ya nyumba.
sw.R: Wakachukua kila kitu ambacho watu walikuwa nacho. Wakawateka wanawake wote na watoto. Wakachukua kila kitu kilichokuwa ndani ya nyumba.

decisions.choice: their little ones and their wives they took captive: the fate of a conquered city
decisions.reason: Women and children of a defeated city were taken away as captives (Numbers 31:9; Deuteronomy 20:14). The marriages Hamor proposed come about by force instead.

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יַעֲקֹ֜ב אֶל־שִׁמְע֣וֹן וְאֶל־לֵוִי֮ עֲכַרְתֶּ֣ם אֹתִי֒ לְהַבְאִישֵׁ֨נִי֙ בְּיֹשֵׁ֣ב הָאָ֔רֶץ בַּֽכְּנַעֲנִ֖י וּבַפְּרִזִּ֑י וַאֲנִי֙ מְתֵ֣י מִסְפָּ֔ר וְנֶאֶסְפ֤וּ עָלַי֙ וְהִכּ֔וּנִי וְנִשְׁמַדְתִּ֖י אֲנִ֥י וּבֵיתִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Jacob to Simeon and to Levi, you have brought trouble on me by making me stink among the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and among the Perizzites; and I [am] men of number, and they will gather against me and strike me, and I will be destroyed, I and my house.

en.L: And Jacob said to Simeon and to Levi, "You have brought trouble on me by making me stink among the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites and the Perizzites. And I [am] few in number; they will gather against me and attack me, and I will be destroyed, I and my household."
en.B: Then Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, "You have brought ruin on me. You have made me hateful to the people who live here, the Canaanites and the Perizzites. My men are few. If those peoples band together and come against me, they will wipe out me and my whole family."
en.R: Then Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, "You have caused me terrible trouble. Now the Canaanites and Perizzites who live in this land will hate me. There are not many of us. If they gather their fighters and come against us, they will kill me and my whole family."

es.L: Y dijo Jacob a Simeón y a Leví: «{{plural_you:Me han|Me habéis}} traído desgracia al hacerme heder entre los habitantes de la tierra, entre los cananeos y los ferezeos. Y yo [soy] poca gente; se juntarán contra mí y me atacarán, y seré destruido, yo y mi casa».
es.B: Entonces Jacob dijo a Simeón y a Leví: «{{plural_you:Me han|Me habéis}} arruinado. {{plural_you:Me han|Me habéis}} hecho odioso ante la gente que vive aquí, los cananeos y los ferezeos. Mis hombres son pocos. Si esos pueblos se unen y vienen contra mí, acabarán conmigo y con toda mi familia».
es.R: Entonces Jacob les dijo a Simeón y a Leví: «{{plural_you:Me han|Me habéis}} causado un problema terrible. Ahora los cananeos y los ferezeos que viven en esta tierra me van a odiar. Somos pocos. Si reúnen a sus guerreros y vienen contra nosotros, nos matarán a mí y a toda mi familia».

fr.L: Et Jacob dit à Siméon et à Lévi : « Vous m’avez attiré le malheur en me rendant puant aux habitants du pays, aux Cananéens et aux Phéréziens. Et moi, [je suis] peu nombreux ; ils se rassembleront contre moi et me frapperont, et je serai détruit, moi et ma maison. »
fr.B: Alors Jacob dit à Siméon et à Lévi : « Vous m’avez perdu. Vous m’avez rendu odieux aux habitants de ce pays, les Cananéens et les Phéréziens. Mes hommes sont peu nombreux. Si ces peuples s’unissent et marchent contre moi, ils m’extermineront avec toute ma famille. »
fr.R: Alors Jacob a dit à Siméon et à Lévi : « Vous m’avez causé de terribles ennuis. Maintenant, les Cananéens et les Phéréziens qui habitent ce pays vont me haïr. Nous sommes peu nombreux. S’ils rassemblent leurs combattants et viennent contre nous, ils me tueront avec toute ma famille. »

sw.L: Naye Yakobo akawaambia Simeoni na Lawi, "Mmeniletea taabu kwa kunifanya ninuke kati ya wakaaji wa nchi, kati ya Wakanaani na Waperizi. Nami [ni] watu wachache; watakusanyika dhidi yangu na kunishambulia, nami nitaangamizwa, mimi na nyumba yangu."
sw.B: Ndipo Yakobo akawaambia Simeoni na Lawi, "Mmeniletea maangamizi. Mmenifanya nichukiwe na watu wanaoishi hapa, Wakanaani na Waperizi. Watu wangu ni wachache. Mataifa hayo yakiungana na kunijia, yataniangamiza mimi pamoja na jamaa yangu yote."
sw.R: Kisha Yakobo akawaambia Simeoni na Lawi, "Mmeniletea taabu kubwa. Sasa Wakanaani na Waperizi wanaoishi katika nchi hii watanichukia. Sisi ni wachache. Wakikusanya wapiganaji wao na kutushambulia, wataniua mimi na jamaa yangu yote."

decisions.choice: brought trouble: 'akhar, to stir up disaster
decisions.reason: The word is the one behind the valley of Achor, where Achan brought disaster on Israel (Joshua 7:25-26).

decisions.choice: making me stink: making me hated
decisions.reason: To make someone stink (hiv'ish) among others is to make him odious to them (Exodus 5:21; 1 Samuel 13:4).

decisions.choice: men of number: few, easy to count
decisions.reason: A group that can be counted is a small one (Deuteronomy 4:27). Jacob's company could not stand against the peoples of the land.

decisions.choice: the Canaanites and the Perizzites: the peoples of the land
decisions.reason: The pair names the settled population of the hill country, as in 13:7. The Perizzites were probably village dwellers.

source.text: וַיֹּאמְר֑וּ הַכְזוֹנָ֕ה יַעֲשֶׂ֖ה אֶת־אֲחוֹתֵֽנוּ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And they said, like a prostitute should he treat our sister?

en.L: And they said, "Should he treat our sister like a prostitute?"
en.B: But they answered, "Was he to be allowed to use our sister as if she were a prostitute?"
en.R: But Simeon and Levi answered, "Should we have let Shechem treat our sister like a prostitute?"

es.L: Y ellos dijeron: «¿Como a una prostituta había de tratar a nuestra hermana?».
es.B: Pero ellos respondieron: «¿Íbamos a permitir que tratara a nuestra hermana como a una prostituta?».
es.R: Pero Simeón y Leví respondieron: «¿Debíamos dejar que Siquem tratara a nuestra hermana como a una prostituta?».

fr.L: Et ils dirent : « Devait-il traiter notre sœur comme une prostituée ? »
fr.B: Mais ils répondirent : « Fallait-il le laisser traiter notre sœur comme une prostituée ? »
fr.R: Mais Siméon et Lévi ont répondu : « Est-ce qu’il fallait laisser Sichem traiter notre sœur comme une prostituée ? »

sw.L: Nao wakasema, "Je, amtendee dada yetu kama kahaba?"
sw.B: Lakini wao wakajibu, "Je, tumwache amtumie dada yetu kana kwamba ni kahaba?"
sw.R: Lakini Simeoni na Lawi wakajibu, "Je, tungemwacha Shekemu amtendee dada yetu kama kahaba?"

decisions.choice: should he treat our sister like a prostitute?: the brothers have the last word
decisions.reason: The chapter ends with their question and no reply. Jacob's answer comes only on his deathbed, when he curses their anger (49:5-7). The narrator leaves the reader to weigh both the wrong done to Dinah and the brothers' slaughter.

decisions.choice: Simeon and Levi; Should we have let Shechem
decisions.reason: Readable names the speakers and the man meant by "he", and shows the question as a reply to Jacob's blame.
